strings.Each course works through mechanism, qua: Isifundo ngasinye sidlula endleleni yokusebenza, isibonelo sezinombolo, ukuqinisekisa nokuxilonga ukwehluleka: kusukela kulithografi ye-EUV, i-interferometri nezibonakhulu ze-elektroni kuya emithonjeni yokukhanya ye-synchrotron, izitholi zamagagasi okudonsela phansi nezibonakude ezinkulu. Isigaba sokuqala sesifundo ngasinye simahhala.

strings.Cloud accounts are not configured on thi: Ama-akhawunti efu awakalungiselelwa kule webhusayithi. Amaphrofayela okufunda asendaweni nokuthunyelwa kwenqubekela phambili kusatholakala.
